text:
olivia: Drafting a small IA update for Console navigation — sidebar regrouping, breadcrumbs, deep links. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/console-ia (draft) — PTAL. Core goals: simpler left nav, consistent deep links, predictable breadcrumbs, accessible keyboard nav.

sam: Quick Q — will existing bookmarks/links keep working? need redirects?

raj: If we change routes we should add server-side 301s and a client-side redirect map. Also would help to version route schemas. Example mapping I sketched:
```
/projects/:pid/models -> /projects/:pid/artifacts/models
/projects/:pid/overview -> /projects/:pid/summary
/projects/:pid/deployments/:did -> /projects/:pid/instances/:did
```
We can keep old paths for 6 months.

olivia: Sidebar regrouping idea:
- Top group: Projects (Projects, Create project)
- Model lifecycle: Models, Uploads, Versions
- Serving: Deployments, Instances, Routing
- Observability: Metrics, Logs, Alerts
- Settings: Access, Billing, Integrations
Names are short for compactness on small screens.

maria: A11y nits:
- Ensure sidebar uses semantic <nav> with aria-label
- Keyboard: left nav arrow key movement + Enter to open
- Breadcrumbs need aria-current for last item
- Deep links should set focus to main heading after navigation
I can draft a checklist.

zoe: Engineering notes:
- We prefer to avoid breaking API consumers — server redirects + client route compatibility is must
- Also consider lazy-loading route chunks to keep bundle sizes down
- Need a migration plan: feature flag rollout -> Canary on Dedicated -> full rollout
- How do we intend to handle permalinks for canary models/specs?

raj: React-router nested route plan + breadcrumbs component example:
```
<Route path="/projects/:pid" element={<ProjectLayout />}> 
  <Route index element={<Overview/>} />
  <Route path="artifacts/models" element={<Models/>} />
  <Route path="instances/:id" element={<Instance/>} />
</Route>
// Breadcrumbs reads route matches and maps to labels
```

olivia: Copy tweaks I propose for sidebar labels: 'Deployments' -> 'Serving', 'Instances' -> 'Run-time', 'Models' -> 'Artifacts' (open to bikeshed). Short, scannable.

sam: We should track click telemetry + deep link opens. Plan an A/B test on the new grouping for 4 weeks: compare task completion rate for 'create deployment' and time-to-first-inference.

deploy-bot: Staging preview deployed: https://staging.console.redwood.ai/preview/console-ia-1763704821 — includes sidebar mock routes and basic breadcrumbs.

zoe: Action items:
- @raj: prototype route compat layer + redirect table (ETA 3d)
- @maria: accessibility checklist + test cases (ETA 2d)
- @olivia: finalize Figma copy and spacing tokens (ETA 2d)
- @sam: telemetry metrics and A/B criteria (ETA 3d)
I'll open an epic and link PRs.

maria: I'll include screen-reader walkthrough scripts and keyboard-only flows. Also color contrast check for new active states.

olivia: Thanks everyone — I'll update Figma and drop a short user note. We'll demo in next design review on Tuesday. :thumbsup:
